name: extra1
caption:
THE NEXT DEMAR? 🎮🏀 DeMar DeRozan was our No. 9 pick and became our all-time leading scorer. Collin Murray-Boyles was our No. 9 pick too.

• DeMar as a rookie (2009-10): 8.6 PPG, 2.9 RPG
• Collin as a rookie (2025-26): 8.5 PPG, 5.0 RPG
• DeMar in year 2 (2010-11): 17.2 PPG, all 82 games
• Collin in year 2, first 12 games: 10.1 PPG, 1.1 SPG

Does Collin make the DeMar jump? 👇

beats.head: THE NEXT DEMAR?
beats.name: DEMAR
beats.vo: DeMar DeRozan was our number nine pick. So is Collin Murray-Boyles. Can he follow the same path?

beats.head: ROOKIE DEMAR
beats.name: DEMAR
beats.vo: DeMar as a rookie: eight point six points a night. Nobody was calling him a star yet.
beats.dlg: DEMAR AS A ROOKIE:|8.6 PPG, 2.9 RPG.

beats.head: ROOKIE COLLIN
beats.name: COLLIN
beats.vo: Collin as a rookie: eight point five. Almost the same, with five rebounds a night.
beats.dlg: COLLIN AS A ROOKIE:|8.5 PPG, 5.0 RPG.

beats.head: THE JUMP
beats.name: DEMAR
beats.vo: Then, in year two, DeMar doubled it. Seventeen point two a night, in all eighty-two games.

beats.head: COLLIN NOW
beats.name: COLLIN
beats.vo: Collin's year two, in his first twelve games: ten point one a night, plus one point one steals.

beats.head: SAME PATH?
beats.vo: Does Collin make the DeMar jump? Yes or no? Comment below.
beats.dlg: DOES COLLIN MAKE THE JUMP?|YES OR NO? COMMENT BELOW!

facts.claim: DeRozan was selected ninth overall (#9) by Toronto in the 2009 NBA draft and became the franchise's all-time leading scorer; his rookie season was 2009-10 and year 2 was 2010-11
Murray-Boyles was chosen ninth overall (#9) in the 2025 NBA draft by Toronto; rookie season 2025-26, year 2 is 2026-27
